stocks.impact_theory: AMD reported Q1 2026 earnings with $10.3B revenue beating estimates, driven by 38% YoY data center growth from AI chips. Economic implications include boosted AI infrastructure spending, reducing reliance on Nvidia. Market psychology: FOMO buying as CPUs gain traction in AI ('CPUs cool again'). Historical parallel: NVDA post-2023 earnings rallies. Analogies: Like Intel's Pentium era chip wars; rocket fuel for AI arms race.

news_impact_analysis.reasoning: Earnings beat, raised guidance on AI/data center (70%+ CPU growth Q2), upgrades from Goldman/Citi. X sentiment positive (up 15%+ mentions), web news rally in chips.

potential_profit_risks.long_position: Long for 10-20% upside on AI momentum, target $450.
potential_profit_risks.short_position: Short if overbought RSI>80 fades, potential 5% pullback.
potential_profit_risks.key_risks: Competition from NVDA/Intel, supply chain issues, broader tech correction.

stocks.justification: Strong earnings beat, AI tailwinds confirmed, high analyst upgrades, positive X/web sentiment.
